nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Electrochemical treatment_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What was the set operating voltage range for the electrochemical tests?
nodes.answer: The operating voltage range was set at -1.0 V to 1.0 V.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Electrochemical treatment_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: For how long was the electrode surface soaked in the supportive electrolyte environment?
nodes.answer: The surface was soaked for 3 hours.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Electrochemical treatment_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How is aluminum produced in the electrolysis process?
nodes.answer: Aluminum is produced by the electrochemical reduction of aluminum ions on the cathode, while oxygen is oxidized on the carbon anodes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Electrochemical treatment_qna_003
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the primary function of bioelectrochemical systems (BESs)?
nodes.answer: BESs are primarily employed to treat wastewater and produce bioenergy, exceeding standard biologic treatment strategies by degrading various organic pollutants and enabling resource recovery.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Electrochemical treatment_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What challenge do bioelectrochemical systems (BESs) currently face regarding their treatment and recovery efficacies?
nodes.answer: The efficacies of treatment and recovery are insufficient to provide high-quality effluents for possible reuse and energy self-sufficiency.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Electrochemical treatment_qna_005
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Who is regarded as the father of bio-electrochemistry?
nodes.answer: Luigi Galvani is regarded as the father of bio-electrochemistry.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Electrochemical treatment_qna_006
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can the optimization of sequential chemical coagulation - electro-oxidation process help in the treatment of industrial textile wastewater according to Lavas and colleagues?
nodes.answer: The optimization of this process can enhance the treatment efficiency of industrial textile wastewater by improving the removal of contaminants.
